    • errorResponse

      CloseOrTerminalStage<RequestFilterResult> errorResponse(io.kroxylicious.kafka.common.message.RequestHeaderData header, io.kroxylicious.kafka.common.protocol.ApiMessage requestMessage, io.kroxylicious.kafka.common.protocol.Errors error) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Generate a short-circuit error response towards the client. The generated error response is API-specific: it carries the given error's code, and the error's default message, either at the top level of the response (if the API for the response has a global error code), or for all entities given in the request (if the API for the response has only per-entity error codes).
      Parameters:
      header - the headers from the request
      requestMessage - the API request message to generate an error in response too.
      error - the error to convey to the client; its code is set on the generated response and its default message is used. Must denote an actual error; Errors.NONE is not permitted.
      Returns:
      next stage in the fluent builder API
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - header or message do not meet criteria described above, or error is Errors.NONE.

    • errorResponse

      CloseOrTerminalStage<RequestFilterResult> errorResponse(io.kroxylicious.kafka.common.message.RequestHeaderData header, io.kroxylicious.kafka.common.protocol.ApiMessage requestMessage, io.kroxylicious.kafka.common.protocol.Errors error, @Nullable String message) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Generate a short-circuit error response towards the client. The generated error response is API-specific: it carries the given error's code, and the given message, either at the top level of the response (if the API for the response has a global error code), or for all entities given in the request (if the API for the response has only per-entity error codes).
      Parameters:
      header - the headers from the request
      requestMessage - the API request message to generate an error in response too.
      error - the error to convey to the client; its code is set on the generated response. Must denote an actual error; Errors.NONE is not permitted.
      message - the error message to convey to the client, or null to use the error's default message.
      Returns:
      next stage in the fluent builder API
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - header or message do not meet criteria described above, or error is Errors.NONE.
